preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 1000) representing the matrix size.
The input consists of exactly N+1 lines: the first line is N, followed by N lines of matrix data.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the N matrix lines contains exactly N space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for num in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each cell value in the matrix is an integer between 1 and 100 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the total number of decreasing paths modulo 10^9+7.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N for x in range(1, N+1) for y in range(1, N+1) for path in paths_from_cell(x, y) if all(1 <= nx <= N and 1 <= ny <= N for nx, ny in path[1:]))
postconditions.description: For every cell (x,y) in the matrix (1-based), every path starting at (x,y) stays within the matrix bounds (1 ≤ row, col ≤ N).

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[x-1][y-1] > matrix[nx-1][ny-1] for x in range(1, N+1) for y in range(1, N+1) for path in paths_from_cell(x, y) for (nx, ny) in zip(path, path[1:]))
postconditions.description: For every path starting at (x,y), each subsequent cell in the path has a strictly smaller value than the previous cell.

postconditions.expression: sum(len(paths_from_cell(x, y)) for x in range(1, N+1) for y in range(1, N+1)) == int(stdout)
postconditions.description: The total number of valid decreasing paths (including single-cell paths) across all cells equals the output modulo 10^9+7.
